verdict.rationale: AI-generated insights are a fair question for an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, so the axis applies. The pack shows only conventional features: a Custom Payroll Report under Analytics and automatic holiday date designation. Neither is AI-generated insight or suggestion, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
